 137 │ 
 138 │ ## Markdown
 139 │ 
 140 │ Rich can render markdown and does a reasonable job of translating the formatting to the terminal.
 141 │ 
 142 │ To render markdown import the `Markdown` class and construct it with a string containing markdown code. Then print it to the console. Here's an example:
 143 │ 
 144 │ ```python
 145 │ from rich.console import Console
 146 │ from rich.markdown import Markdown
 147 │ 
 148 │ console = Console()
 149 │ with open("README.md") as readme:
 150 │     markdown = Markdown(readme.read())
 151 │ console.print(markdown)
 152 │ ```
 153 │

 155 │ 
 156 │ ![markdown](https://github.com/willmcgugan/rich/raw/master/imgs/markdown.png)
 157 │ 
 158 │ ## Syntax Highlighting
 159 │ 
 160 │ Rich uses the [pygments](https://pygments.org/) library to implement syntax highlighting. Usage is similar to rendering markdown; construct a `Syntax` object and print it to the console. Here's an example:
 161 │ 
 162 │ ```python
 163 │ from rich.console import Console
 164 │ from rich.syntax import Syntax
 165 │ 
 166 │ my_code = '''
 167 │ def iter_first_last(values: Iterable[T]) -> Iterable[Tuple[bool, bool, T]]:
 168 │     """Iterate and generate a tuple with a flag for first and last value."""
 169 │     iter_values = iter(values)
 170 │     try:
 171 │         previous_value = next(iter_values)
 172 │     except StopIteration:
 173 │         return
 174 │     first = True
 175 │     for value in iter_values:
 176 │         yield first, False, previous_value
 177 │         first = False
 178 │         previous_value = value
 179 │     yield first, True, previous_value
 180 │ '''
 181 │ syntax = Syntax(my_code, "python", theme="monokai", line_numbers=True)
 182 │ console = Console()
 183 │ console.print(syntax)
 184 │ ```

 187 │

 189 │ 
 190 │ ## Tables
 191 │ 
 192 │ Rich can render flexible tables with unicode box characters. There is a large variety of formatting options for borders, styles, cell alignment etc. Here's a simple example:
 193 │ 
 194 │ ```python
 195 │ from rich.console import Console
 196 │ from rich.table import Column, Table
 197 │ 
 198 │ console = Console()
 199 │ 
 200 │ table = Table(show_header=True, header_style="bold magenta")
 201 │ table.add_column("Date", style="dim", width=12)
 202 │ table.add_column("Title")
 203 │ table.add_column("Production Budget", justify="right")
 204 │ table.add_column("Box Office", justify="right")
 205 │ table.add_row(
 206 │     "Dev 20, 2019", "Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker", "$275,000,0000", "$375,126,118"
 207 │ )
 208 │ table.add_row(
 209 │     "May 25, 2018",
 210 │     "[red]Solo[/red]: A Star Wars Story",
 211 │     "$275,000,0000",
 212 │     "$393,151,347",
 213 │ )
 214 │ table.add_row(
 215 │     "Dec 15, 2017",
 216 │     "Star Wars Ep. VIII: The Last Jedi",
 217 │     "$262,000,000",
 218 │     "[bold]$1,332,539,889[/bold]",
 219 │ )

 221 │ console.print(table)
 222 │ ```
